fitReason: Research-method backup: direct current VLA/HRL and learning-based construction robotics, with unusually concrete external-master’s hosting precedent. Recent learned physical execution remains unverified; rank below established physical robot-learning hosts.

physicalEvidence.summary: Current VLA/HRL benchmark runs in MuJoCo; hand-aware VLA workshop evaluation uses RoboTwin; LLM-PCPP plans on simulated grids even when maps derive from real drone imagery. The 2026 camera-safety prototype tracks people and checks trajectories in Unity, rather than documenting actual emergency-stop robot integration. Actual 2026 JetAuto Pro laboratory point-cloud collection establishes hardware experience, but its reviewed methods are geometric SLAM/calibration rather than neural robot perception/control. No learned physical-execution credit is assigned. Historical Michigan construction robotics is acknowledged without assuming current Stony Brook hardware access.

shortVisit.summary: The current official lab roster lists Cheng-Yun Tsai as a former visiting MS student from National Taiwan University. His university-published account describes six months of research in CROSS Lab, continuing computer vision/machine learning and participating in an industry project. This proves a relevant external-master’s precedent, but not an eight-week offer. Current homepage recruitment explicitly addresses SBU master’s/undergraduate students and says PhD positions are unavailable; neither statement establishes external visitor intake.
